mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we have overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 66 degrees and an air quality index of 55. The moon is currently in its third quarter phase.
The city recently updated its records on engineering services, and you can also sign up for the free tri-shaw bike program at the Senior Center for a scenic ride on the Military Ridge State Trail.
Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch a performance during our Concerts in the Park series.
In a notable report from July 31st, an officer stopped a vehicle for a equipment violation and arrested the driver for an O W I.
Today you can enjoy the Chocolate Caramel Twist at Culver's, which is currently closed but opens its doors at 10 AM. Tomorrow the flavor will be Really Reese's.
